description: This file defines the AuthProviderChain class, which manages a chain of authentication providers enabling layered authentication strategies in the OrangeHRM system. It allows adding multiple authentication providers with priorities and attempts to authenticate using them in order.

classes.name: AuthProviderChain
classes.description: Manages a chain of authentication providers, allowing addition with priority checking and sequential authentication attempts.

methods.name: addProvider
methods.description: Adds an authentication provider to the chain, ensuring no duplicate classes or conflicting priorities are registered.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Iterates over the registered providers in order of priority and attempts authentication; returns true if successful.
